summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of Tidepaper Chat application. All backend APIs (23/23 tests) and frontend user stories (8/8 stories) passed successfully. The chatbot features multi-provider LLM support (OpenAI GPT-5, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini), session management, auto-title generation, multi-turn conversation memory, markdown rendering with code syntax highlighting, and a premium UI with Tidepaper theme.
passed_tests: Backend: Health check (GET /api/) returns ok
Backend: Models endpoint (GET /api/models) returns 3 providers with default openai/gpt-5
Backend: Create session (POST /api/sessions) with default title 'New conversation'
Backend: List sessions (GET /api/sessions) sorted newest-first
Backend: Rename session (PATCH /api/sessions/{id}) updates title
Backend: Change model (PATCH /api/sessions/{id}) switches provider/model
Backend: Invalid model validation returns 400
Backend: Get messages (GET /api/sessions/{id}/messages) returns history
Backend: Send message (POST /api/sessions/{id}/messages) returns user + AI response
Backend: Empty message validation returns 400
Backend: Unknown session validation returns 404
Backend: Auto-title feature renames 'New conversation' on first message
Backend: Multi-turn memory preserves context across messages
Backend: Provider switching works for Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini
Backend: Delete session (DELETE /api/sessions/{id}) cascades messages
Frontend Story 1: Create new chat via 'New chat' button, new session appears at top
Frontend Story 2: User message and AI reply render with proper bubble styling and markdown
Frontend Story 3: Page refresh restores conversation list and message history
Frontend Story 4: Rename conversation via '...' menu -> Rename, title persists
Frontend Story 5: Delete conversation via '...' menu -> Delete with AlertDialog confirmation
Frontend Story 6: Switch models via top-right Select, updates active session model
Frontend Story 7: Code blocks render with syntax highlighting and Copy button
Frontend Story 8: Empty state appears when no sessions or no session selected
